articles.summary: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. (NASDAQ: MIGI) (“Mawson'' or the “Company”), a digital infrastructure provider, announces today that it has signed and closed a binding sale agreement for Mawson’s greenfield sites in Midland, TX, effective April 18, 2023. The sale price was $8.5m in cash and stablecoins.
articles.title: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. Sells Greenfield Texas Sites for $8.5m
